value: Colvin C & Chopra S 2026, 'Population-scale transcriptomics reveals host genetic control of phyllosphere fungal communities'
note: DIRECT PRIOR ART for crypt's detection premise, and it reanalyses two of our largest projects. Abstract: 'standard polyA-enriched RNA sequencing of plant leaf tissue, without targeted microbial enrichment, captures sufficient fungal transcripts to enable quantitative profiling of metabolically active mycobiomes at scale. Although fungal transcripts represented only 0.03-0.4% of classified reads ... this still yielded 79 million fungal reads across 2,194 field-collected samples (median = 5,260-59,746 reads per sample), enabling robust quantification of several hundred fungal taxa.' Three datasets: PRJEB83049 sorghum 822, PRJEB67964 maize 750 (WiDiv panel, Lincoln NE 2020), GSA CRA009979 soybean 622 (Sanya, China - not in SRA, so absent from our tables). NOTE THE DIFFERENCE IN QUESTION: Col26 asks whether host genotype controls phyllosphere community composition (GWAS/TWAS of fungal relative abundance). crypt asks whether field samples sequenced for one pathogen carry UNREPORTED pathogen co-infections at a higher rate than controlled conditions. Overlapping method, different claim. But it does mean the fungi in these two projects have now been reported by a third party, so 'cryptic' is weaker for them than for a project nobody has mined - the original authors still reported nothing. Fetch: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.05.21.727028v1.full-text

value: PRJNA825139 (185 runs) needs Supplementary Table S1 to be split
note: The PPR paper (Luo et al. 2022) claims PRJNA825139 in its data availability, but it has at least THREE sequencing arms and the 185 runs carry 74 distinct sample-name bases with no key in the main text. The arms: (1) a growth-chamber hydroponic panel on Nipponbare - 'cultured in the nutrient solution proposed by Yoshida et al. in a growth chamber (16 h light at 30 C and 8 h dark at 25 C) for 15 days', then PEG6000 / H2O2 / NaCl / antimycin A and ABA / GA4 / IAA / CTK / ethephon, 'Two or three biological replicates were used (Supplementary Table S1)'; (2) the Baihe field experiment 2016, two nearby fields, a drought DT field July 5 to Aug 15 and a drip-irrigated CK control field, transplanted 15 June; (3) CRISPR-Cas9 knockout mutants ppr035-1,2,3 and ppr406-1,2,3 plus WT, 'bred to generate T3 for further field and laboratory experiments'. Only 39 of the 185 runs carry a CK or DT token, and inferring 'field' from a token alone is exactly the kind of guess that produced the LMAD/LMAD26 trap. The rest read AP126/AP184/AP196/AP902/APWT, M133b/N133b/M133b_NIP, WC1L/WC2L/WT1L, AA, A1-A3, B1-B3, C1-C2. WANTED: Supplementary Table S1 (Frontiers Data_Sheet_1.XLSX), which the paper cites as the sample list. Tried and failed: Frontiers article page is JS-rendered with no file links; frontiersin.org/api/v3/articles/926285/file/Data_Sheet_1.zip is 404; Europe PMC's supplementaryFiles for PMC9343880 returns a 10 KB HTML error; both NCBI and EuropePMC /bin/ paths refuse Data_Sheet_1.XLSX through Data_Sheet_4.pdf.
